description: Establish where active promoters lie in parental Hs27 fibroblasts, as a baseline for interpreting the transcription factor perturbation experiments carried out in this cell line. The histone modification H3K4me3 was profiled by CUT&RUN in two biological replicates and reported as genome-wide coverage normalized for sequencing depth.

Establish where active enhancers and promoters lie in parental Hs27 fibroblasts, as a baseline for interpreting the transcription factor perturbation experiments carried out in this cell line. The histone modification H3K27ac was profiled by CUT&RUN in two biological replicates and reported as genome-wide coverage normalized for sequencing depth.

Establish where polycomb-repressed chromatin lies in parental Hs27 fibroblasts, as a baseline for interpreting the transcription factor perturbation experiments carried out in this cell line. The histone modification H3K27me3 was profiled by CUT&RUN in two biological replicates and reported as genome-wide coverage normalized for sequencing depth.

Measure the non-specific background of the CUT&RUN assay in parental Hs27 fibroblasts, so that signal in the histone modification datasets from the same cells can be told apart from background. A non-specific IgG antibody was substituted for the target antibody in two biological replicates, and the result is reported as genome-wide coverage normalized for sequencing depth.
